**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is experiencing issues with congestion and sinus pressure.  
[FACT] User has been doing inhalation treatments twice a day with a nebulizer machine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to relieve sinus pressure, including staying hydrated, using saline nasal sprays, trying steam inhalation, using a humidifier, applying warm compresses, elevating the head while sleeping, using nasal strips, exercising regularly, considering over-the-counter medications, and consulting a healthcare professional if symptoms persist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended drinking at least 8-10 glasses of fluid per day to stay hydrated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using over-the-counter saline nasal sprays to moisturize nasal passages, loosen mucus, and reduce congestion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide on how to do steam inhalation correctly, including boiling water, adding optional ingredients like eucalyptus oil or menthol, creating a steam tent, inhaling deeply for 5-10 minutes, and how often to do it (2-3 times a day).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended doing steam inhalation 2-3 times a day for sinus pressure and congestion, and 1-2 times a week for maintenance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed specific brands of saline nasal sprays, including Simply Saline, Ocean, Arm & Hammer Simply Saline, Flonase, Nasacort, and Afrin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to look for sodium chloride, purified water, xylitol, glycerin, and aloe vera in saline nasal sprays, and to avoid preservatives, artificial fragrances, and dyes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that saline nasal sprays are suitable for daily use and generally safe for most people.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested monitoring symptoms and consulting a healthcare provider if symptoms persist or worsen.  
[USER] User expressed interest in trying the steam inhalation method and saline nasal sprays to help with congestion.  
[USER] User is unsure if doing inhalation treatments twice a day with the nebulizer machine is enough and is considering increasing the frequency or duration of the treatments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant indicated that the frequency and duration of nebulizer treatments can vary depending on individual needs and severity of congestion, suggesting that the user consider adjusting their treatment schedule.
